managed-lustre-all-month.title: Managed Lustre is billed while it exists; delete it between jobs
managed-lustre-all-month.body: This file system is priced for the whole month, and the context says it is not production. It is billed per GiB-hour from creation until deletion, so if it is only needed while jobs run (for example an idle or non-production file system), hold the data in lower-cost Blob Storage between runs and create the file system only when needed (set hours to the real number of hours).

citation.quote: Instead, you can create a different file system for different jobs and store data in lower-cost Azure blob containers between uses.
